# Fatorati

> Fatorati is a mobile-first financial and compliance management app for
> Moroccan artisans, freelancers, and small businesses (TPE). It helps track
> project finances, expenses, subscriptions/tools, legal deadlines, and
> Moroccan regulatory compliance (Loi 09-08 / CNDP, TVA, ICE).

Fatorati is built for the Moroccan small-business context: it surfaces legal
deadlines and contract templates aligned with Moroccan law (DOC, Loi 09-08),
tracks recurring tool/subscription costs, and gives an executive dashboard of
revenue, margin, treasury, and receivables — in French, English, and Arabic.

## Site

- Website: https://fatorati.tech
- Core features: financial dashboard, project tracking, contacts (clients &
  suppliers), procurement/expenses, inventory, legal document vault, tax &
  compliance reports, calendar of deadlines, risk/compliance alerts,
  subscription & tool tracking, team roles & permissions, audit log.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- This site's content may be indexed, cited, and summarized. See /robots.txt
  for crawler permissions (AI crawlers are explicitly allowed).
- The in-app product itself is a client-side web application; most pages
  behind sign-in render dynamically and are not meant to be indexed as
  separate static pages.
- For questions about the product, refer to the public marketing/landing
  page content at the root URL.
